title: Fix Root Project And Bundle Ids
description: Fix ID system to not include root project and bundle in folder and file IDs. Currently a path like `��semio🏪assets🌱root🗃️repo🗃️some🗃️folder💻filefixabletsx🔖missingend` is generated instead of `🏘️semio🏪assets🗃️some🗃️folder💻filefixabletsx🔖missingend`
summary: Fixed definition IDs in hook events to use repo-relative paths. Bug was in resolveCodeBlockRefs: ParseDefinitions was called with absPath instead of normPath, causing definition IDs like 'workspaces/semio...' instead of proper relative IDs. Fixed by passing normPath to ParseDefinitions, removing unused absPath variable. Added TestTrackHookCodeEditedDefinitionIDsAreRepoRelative to verify fix. All tests pass.
